listing.name: Twisted Metal 2 — TwistedMetal1234Recomp (jcoker85)
listing.summary: Experimental project. This is the native Windows TM2 profile within the four-title kit. A complete TM2 playthrough has not been independently established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 USA TwistedMetal2 retail SCUS94306 CHD or CUE/BIN; do not inherit TM1/3/4 source revisions.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the shared Windows launcher and tools/generate.sh setup, selecting tm2 with your own SCUS94306 disc. The shared launcher and runtime belong to the same implementation.

warnings: This is the native Windows TM2 profile within the four-title kit. A complete TM2 playthrough has not been independently established.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
